messages:
tyler: Hey team — first week onboarding question. I tried to access the EU billing account and create a GCS bucket in europe-west1 but the console shows "You do not have permission to view billing account". Anyone know what exact IAM roles I need or who to ping to get the billing link attached to my project?

anjali: Welcome! :wave: For billing you usually need the Billing Account User on the billing account and Project Billing Manager on the project. If you need to create resources in the project also add Storage Admin for buckets.

tyler: Got it — do you mean roles/billing.user and roles/billing.projectManager? Trying to map to the IAM role names for the access request form.

matt: roles/billing.user is the billing account-level role. For project-level billing link it's roles/billing.projectManager (or roles/billing.user on the project in some setups). Also if you need to create service accounts request roles/iam.serviceAccountCreator.

anjali: Yep matt is right. When you file the IT request include: project_id, project number, which billing account to attach (we have EU and global), and the cost_center tag. Link to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/cloud-access (see "Request billing link" section).

tyler: Is there a self-serve form or should I ping someone directly? I don't want to block my work on the data prep for the evals run.

anjali: Please use the cloud-access form (IT ticket). If you’re in a hurry ping linda in IT after you create the ticket and she'll expedite. Also include the justification and the quota needs (region + CPU/GPU) if relevant.

devops-bot: New ticket created: #IT-8472 by tyler — Subject: "Attach EU billing account + storage/admin for project redwood-eval-01". ETA: 24–48h.

linda (IT): Hi @tyler, I’m taking this. Quick checklist: I need the project number, the billing account ID (EU: 0123-4567-8901) and confirmation you want the Storage Admin and Service Account Creator roles. If you also need specific quotas (CPUs in europe-west1 or GPUs) mention approximate numbers.

tyler: Thanks! Project number is 987654321, please attach EU billing 0123-4567-8901 and grant roles/storage.admin + roles/iam.serviceAccountCreator. No GPUs yet, probably just 8 vCPUs to start. Filing the ticket now and pinging here after.

matt: FYI to check your current bindings you can run: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy PROJECT_ID --format=json` and inspect. Also to see billing link: `gcloud beta billing projects describe PROJECT_ID`

anjali: One more: add `labels.cost_center=platform` to the ticket so finance tags match.

tyler: Done — ticket updated and pinged linda. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:

linda (IT): Got it, I’ll do the attach and add the roles. Will update ticket when done.

tyler: Awesome, thank you!
